description.short_caption: Sabouraud dextrose agar with white fungal colonies.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Sabouraud dextrose agar plate with multiple white, raised, and smooth fungal colonies. The colonies are distributed in streak patterns, suggesting streak plating for isolation. The agar appears translucent with no visible pigmentation from the colonies. This medium is commonly used for culturing fungi.

description.short_caption: Microscopic morphology of fungal growth on cornmeal agar.
description.detailed_description: This is a high-magnification microscopic image showing fungal growth on cornmeal agar. The image reveals branching pseudohyphae and clusters of round to oval yeast cells, characteristic of certain fungal species. The pseudohyphae appear segmented, and the yeast cells are budding. The background is clear, consistent with a laboratory preparation for fungal morphology assessment.
visible_findings: clusters of round to oval yeast cells
